title: should reset field list pagination to page 1 when switching to another stream via the dropdown
verifies: selecting a different stream via the dropdown snaps the field-list pagination back to page 1 (page 1 primary, page 2 ghost)

title: should reset field list pagination to page 1 when selecting a stream via quick pick
verifies: re-selecting a stream via the no-stream quick pick resets the field-list pagination to page 1

title: should reset field list pagination to page 1 when the field list search term changes
verifies: typing a new field-list search term resets the field-list pagination to page 1
